outcome: relative abundance of arsenic-metabolizing bacterial gene pathways
cohort: Infants from the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study (n=190).
finding: Urinary total arsenic levels were associated with the increased relative abundance of several arsenic-related bacterial gene pathways in the infant gut microbiome, with stronger associations observed at six weeks of age compared to one year.
mod_finding: Many associations between arsenic-metabolizing bacteria and urinary arsenic excretion were stronger among operatively-delivered infants compared to vaginally-delivered infants.
